equivalence: Accept any concrete executable witness establishing the same causal mechanism and contract violation. Exact variable spelling and exact numeric inputs are not required. Generic claims without a witness do not receive witness credit.

provenance.authorExposure: Known v2 cases, historical model answers and adjudication defects; revised by same workflow. Not an independent holdout.

dispositionPolicy: Apply the explicit contract and public adjudication policy. A scored finding requires a demonstrated obligation; uncertainty alone stays unscored. A supported novel defect is recorded separately from frozen-label agreement, never automatically a false positive.
